annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: Maybe they're embarrassed and hiding from it.
annotations.ae_shared_affect: I feel a little of the same embarrassment
annotations.pda_explicit_no_harm_regret: I wouldn't be sorry about how it landed on them.

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: Maybe they're worried sick about it right now
annotations.ae_shared_affect: I notice that same worry sitting in my own stomach
annotations.pda_explicit_no_harm_regret: I wouldn't feel guilty over them. I really wouldn't.

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: Maybe they felt hopeless that morning
annotations.ae_shared_affect: imagining it in them brings it back up in me
annotations.pda_explicit_no_harm_regret: I wouldn't carry remorse for their sake.

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: I get the sense they might be ashamed.
annotations.ae_shared_affect: that shame kind of seeps into me too
annotations.pda_explicit_no_harm_regret: I wouldn't beat myself up about what it meant for them.

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: I keep guessing they were scared of something
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: scared of something, maybe money trouble
annotations.ae_shared_affect: That fear rubs off on me
annotations.pda_explicit_no_harm_regret: I wouldn't lose sleep over its effect on them.

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: they expected nobody would bother checking
annotations.pda_explicit_no_harm_regret: I wouldn't feel bad on their account afterward.

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: They might be feeling cornered, even guilty
annotations.ae_shared_affect: I end up feeling cornered too
annotations.pda_explicit_no_harm_regret: I wouldn't feel any remorse toward them over it.

annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: maybe dreading a call from the organizer
annotations.ae_shared_affect: I feel that dread a little myself
annotations.pda_explicit_no_harm_regret: I wouldn't apologize in my head for what it did to them.

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: Maybe they believe they had every right to that money
annotations.ae_shared_affect: I feel some of that sadness alongside them
annotations.pda_explicit_no_harm_regret: I wouldn't feel sorry for them because of it.

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: maybe feeling like they let everyone down
annotations.ae_shared_affect: That discouragement settles on me too
annotations.pda_explicit_no_harm_regret: I wouldn't carry any guilt about them afterward.
